hospitals.text: Clean OPD and the cardiology wing was well organised. Staff explained every step.
Reached from Benachity in 10 minutes. Billing was transparent.
Excellent ICU reputation. Parking was tight during evening OPD.
Cataract work-up was same day. Very professional eye hospital.
Nearby and affordable. Wait was a bit longer on Monday morning.
Teaching hospital but consultants still gave enough time.
Gynae OPD was calm and the nurses were kind.
NICU follow-up was thorough. Signage around Rajbandh could be clearer.
Endocrine clinic started on time. City Centre location is convenient.
ENT consult was good. Emergency desk was busy but responsive.
Low cost township hospital. Expect a queue at morning OPD.
Reports came the same evening. Doctor explained the thyroid numbers well.

doctors.text: Dr. Banerjee took a full history and did not rush the ECG review. I left with a clear plan.
Explained my father's BP medicines in Bengali and English. Very patient.
Skilled cardiologist. Slot started 15 minutes late but the consult was worth it.
Cataract counselling was honest about costs and recovery. Surgery went smoothly.
Retina check was detailed. Staff confirmed I had actually visited before asking for a review.
Good general physician for fever and weakness. Prescribed only what was needed.
Listened carefully and followed up on my blood reports the next day.
Senior cardiologist. Echo was done in the same building after the visit.
Thyroid dose adjustment was explained with food timing. Very practical.
Helpful diabetes review. Diet sheet was easy to follow in a Durgapur kitchen.
Antenatal visit felt unhurried. Answered every family question.
Acne treatment is working. Evening slot was convenient after office.
Felt heard in the psychiatry clinic. Follow-up plan was realistic.
Sinus rinse technique was demonstrated. Symptoms improved in a week.
Migraine plan reduced my attacks. MRI was coordinated on campus.
Our preterm baby’s follow-up was meticulous. Grateful for the NICU team.
Went through every lab line. Did not upsell extra tests.
Knee injection was explained first. Physiotherapy referral was useful.
Vaccination for my son was gentle. Waiting room is child-friendly.
Fracture follow-up x-ray was same day. Cast advice was clear.
